description:
We are seeking a dedicated SDC/Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines staff development coordination with comprehensive infection prevention and control efforts, ensuring the highest standards of care and staff competency.

The ideal candidate will be instrumental in educating staff on best practices, implementing infection control protocols, and maintaining a safe environment for residents and employees. This position offers an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on quality of care and operational excellence.
requirements: Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to healthcare and infection control

description: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity for a driven professional to make a significant impact in a dynamic environment, focusing on community engagement and census growth.The ideal candidate will be a proactive leader with a proven ability to build relationships and drive results. salaryOrBonusInfo: Highly competitive compensation for the ideal candidate.

description: Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a PRN Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This flexible PRN opportunity allows you to provide essential therapy services, contributing to patient recovery and well-being on an as-needed basis. You will work alongside a dedicated team, helping patients regain function and improve their quality of life through personalized treatment plans.As a PRN PTA, you will play a crucial role in delivering high-quality rehabilitative care. This position offers the flexibility to balance your professional commitments while making a significant impact in a supportive environment. We are seeking a compassionate and skilled professional eager to contribute to our mission of exceptional patient care.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant program
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility is preferred
Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly compensation ranges from $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.

description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Family Medicine Physician in Greenville, SC. We are seeking a physician to join our team, offering a highly competitive compensation package that includes a robust base salary and significant bonus potential. This role provides a chance to make a real impact within a supportive environment.

We offer a non-negotiable base salary starting at $210,000 per year, complemented by a bonus structure that can reach up to $50,000. This includes a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 in potential bonuses. A $9,000 sign-on bonus is available on payday one for eligible candidates. We also provide great benefits, generous paid time off, and are open to candidates requiring travel or relocation assistance.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped
Active medical license in South Carolina or eligibility to obtain
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $210,000 per year, with a guaranteed bonus of $25,000 and an additional potential bonus of $25,000. A $9,000 sign-on bonus is available on payday one with a promissory note. Relocation assistance is also available.
